rg --files; cat README.md CLAUDE.md docs/features/README.md docs/runbooks/README.md docs/glossary.md; git log -6 --oneline

git diff --check; git diff --stat; python3 - <<'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
files = [Path('docs/README.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md'), Path('docs/adr/README.md')]
count = 0
for file in files:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', file.read_text()):
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = file.parent / name if name else file
        assert dest.is_file(), f'{file}: missing {target}'
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            assert anchor in [re.sub(r'[^\w -]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings], f'{file}: missing anchor {target}'
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} documentation links and their anchors.')
PY
